title: Group CD2 – original area-link review for the 92 historically unresolved locations
limitations: Each of the 68 listed original or contextually related area URLs was attempted through web access, but only 7 returned readable content. Some readable URLs describe nearby DIFFERENT locations and must not be used as proof for a candidate. The other 61 did not return readable detail in that attempt (block, error, stale cache or other availability). These counts do not establish that 690 original archive source links were individually opened, or that the eight directory sites were exhaustively searched for each candidate. Third-party historical index snippets are not confirmed 2026 encounters.
